lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately four horizontal tiers of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gill slits along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect the horizontal tiers of blobs, forming a matrix of nodes across the visible mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Prominent horizontal ridges exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient (luminance maxima on the upper edge, minima on the lower edge) running parallel along the upper flank.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small, high-luminance blobs on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger-scale grid on the primary flank.
